resources.string:
Material 3 Expressive

  • Follows system light/dark mode
  • Scalloped clock dial, accent hands and centre dots
  • Wavy stopwatch and timer rings
  • Pill keypad with press-to-morph keys
  • Floating pill navigation and rounded snackbars
  • Google Sans throughout
  • Material clock picker and dialogs
  • Expressive analog and digital widgets

Alarms

  • Skip the next occurrence of a repeating alarm
  • One-time alarms on a chosen date
  • Wake-up challenges: maths, shake or type a phrase
  • Sunrise screen while the alarm rings
  • Wake-up stats
  • Bedtime reminder

Timer and clock

  • Editable timer presets
  • Timer names and countdown in notifications
  • Day/night indicator for world clocks
  • Weather on the Clock tab
